estimator: Extract sustained onset from far_core mean PDOS over native strips 0 and 15. This is the original regional estimator; it differs from averaging independently extracted strip edges in the spatial fit.

F.interpretation: Method-sensitivity envelope, not statistical confidence interval.

R.interpretation: Method-sensitivity envelope, not statistical confidence interval.

F.energy_origin: Each contact-system Fermi level is zero.

R.energy_origin: Each contact-system Fermi level is zero.

representation.PDOS: Raw atom-projected DOS converted from states/Hartree to states/eV; strips 0 and 15, 12 Mo + 24 S (12 f.u.), excludes Au.
representation.normalization: states per eV per MoS2 formula unit
representation.energy_origin: Each contact-system Fermi energy is zero.
representation.log_zero_display: Native zeros are masked on the log axis; numerical values remain unchanged and no floor is inserted.
representation.overlapping_points: All 81 rows are drawn; coincident settings visually overlap.

limitations: Atom-PDOS threshold onsets are spectral proxies; isolated-layer band projections and transmission are not available.
Finite periodic wire arrays: farthest Mo columns are only about 15.5 A (F) and 16.5 A (R) from Au projection.
Far-band-edge plateau is tested within this cell; lateral-size and k-mesh convergence are not established.
PBE-DZP, NoSpin without explicit SOC; fixed supplied geometries. These are not quasiparticle or measured barriers.
F/R differ in Au count, wire width and contact area; their difference is not an isolated shape effect.
Metal-contacted MoS2 has appreciable in-gap DOS; no unique vertical band-edge barrier is assigned there.
Gaussian smoothing is a postprocessing sensitivity test, not an assumed physical lifetime or temperature broadening.
